_comment: kilnCtl coupling-matrix preset. DATA ONLY -- never compiled into any
firmware image (see tools/PcTools/README.md 'Config presets').
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: commit 78f2134 ('adopt the coupling matrix')
edited tools/PcTools/config_presets/tuned_baseline_20260831.json to
carry this matrix, but that file is NOT a preset -- its contents are
{"kind":"kilnctl_backup","version":4,"profiles":[...]}, a full board
backup that happens to sit in the config_presets directory (same shape
as pid_validation_backup.json alongside it). list_config_presets()
rejects both with 'missing required field name'. The matrix that commit
adopted was written into a file config_presets.py's loader cannot load
at all, and there was additionally no field mapping in
zones_http_client.py for coupling_coeff -- build_post_body() raised
ZonesHttpUnknownFieldError on it. THIS preset carries the same matrix
in a real, schema-valid preset file, now that zones_http_client.py has
a coupling_coeff mapping (see that module's _PRESET_ZONE_COUPLING_FIELD).
The two misfiled backups are left exactly as they are -- they are
backups, not presets, and are out of this file's scope to fix.
THE MATRIX, [affected][stepped], diagonal zero (measured coupling-step
identification, adopted 2026-08-31 per commit 813ad90's series):
Each zone's "coupling_coeff" list below is that zone's own ROW: entry j
is how many degrees THIS zone rises per the firmware's fitted units when
zone j is the one being stepped -- exactly the orientation GET /api/zones
already emits per zone as coupling_c0..c{N-1} (zones_http_handlers.c line
~332) and parse_zone_fields() expects back as z%u_coupling_c%u (line
~956). The diagonal entry (index == the zone's own index) is 0 in every
row above and is never overlaid by zones_http_client.py's expansion --
the firmware force-ranges it to [0,0] regardless of what is posted.
EVERY OTHER PER-ZONE FIELD BELOW (relay_mask, control_mode, cal_offset_c,
the PID gains, max_ramp_c_per_hr, max_temp_c, min_temp_c) is copied
VERBATIM from a read-only GET /api/zones against the live bench board
(192.168.1.156) taken while writing this preset, specifically so that
applying this preset changes ONLY the coupling matrix -- it does not
carry this bench's PID gains as an opinion, it echoes back exactly what
the board already had so apply_preset()'s unconditional PID/model write
over the UART CONTROL task is a no-op on this bench.
THE WORKING PATH to put this on a live board (see
firmware/KilnFW/docs/PID_EXPANSION_PLAN.md sec 3.2, corrected alongside
this file): config_presets.load_preset_data('coupling_matrix_20260831'),
then config_presets.apply_preset(control, preset, zones_host=<esp-ip>) --
coupling_coeff has no UART setter, so zones_host must be given or the
matrix is reported in not_written and never reaches the board at all.
name: coupling_matrix_20260831
description: Adopted 3-zone coupling matrix (commit 78f2134's measurement, correctly packaged this time) overlaid on this bench's current PID/relay/limit config so applying it changes only the coupling matrix.
